title: light gooey arabian cheese pull
description: a light, saudi-arabian dish featuring orange zest and a gooey cheese pull that's perfect for breakfast, lunch, or dinner. this lacto-vegetarian recipe is easy to make and requires minimal ingredients.
instructions: in a small saucepan, melt the butter over medium heat.
add the orange zest, salt, thyme, and garlic to the saucepan and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
add the feta cheese to the saucepan and stir until it starts to melt.
place the whole wheat pita on a baking sheet and brush the top with olive oil.
place a spoonful of the cheese mixture onto the center of each pita.
fold the pita in half and place it on the baking sheet.
drizzle the lemon juice over the top of each pita.
bake in the preheated oven for 10-12 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
